title: Maurice Hill witnessed the 1952 Washington DC UFO flyover
summary: Lou Elizondo tells of Maurice Hill witnessed the 1952 Washington DC UFO flyover, about 1952 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this gentleman here Mr Hill was living here in Washington DC in 1952 during the famous UFO incident here over Washington

plain: Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who has spoken publicly about UFOs, says that a man named Maurice Hill was living in Washington DC in 1952. That was the year of a well known event when strange lights were reported flying over the US capital, near the Capitol building. Elizondo tells it to show that Hill was a living witness to that famous night.
